THE REDUCTION
The runaway greenhouse is the condition in which vapor pressure reaches ambient, so the published inner edge of the habitable zone is τ = TL and nothing else. Reduced flux s = S/S_runaway is therefore torsion read on the flux axis, and the IVA floor lands at s = 0.88.

d_in = √(L/S_run) · d_out = √(L/0.88·S_run)
d_out/d_in = √(25/22), every stellar term cancelling.

Phase holding over an eccentric orbit:
e·s/(1−e²)² < 3/100

Nothing on this page is fitted. L comes from 4πR²σT⁴ on the catalogue's own stellar radius and effective temperature; everything else follows.
PRECISION
Two kinds of number share this screen. √(25/22) and the Torsion Limit carry full digits — they have no stellar input at all. A planet's τ carries the digits of its own catalogue row, three or four for most stellar radii and temperatures. The ratio is exact everywhere; the reading is as precise as its star.

Edges carry τ = TL × 2√3 / Δ, Δ the gap in mutual Hill radii. Gladman (1993): two orbits can never cross when Δ > 2√3, so Δ = 2√3 ↔ τ = TL.
